venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD JK).** Net sales $2,014 vs target $1,362 (+47.9%). Food $421. 55 guests, $36.63 check avg. Comps $28.70. Second trivia Wednesday; Maddie stood in for Nicole with great energy, returning group from last week plus new guests drawn by signs; first-time member from Manhattan loved it. 10pm birthday round. Reminders: speak to activations (happy hour all day Mondays) and keep up on cocktail specs. Kitchen: chill day, prepare for weekend. Maintenance: decorations in bathroom hall fell. 86: Dusse. No incidents. Favorite moment: guests returning for a second time to play trivia.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD & Chef MD & KK).** Net sales $1,399 vs target $1,545 (-9.4%). Food $5 — kitchen closed all service due to illness, chips offered. 47 guests, $29.77 check avg. Comps $43.85 (3.1%) — Bingo credit, Neuhoff employee, F&F, industry, gift. Calm steady Wednesday, mostly trivia participants early with regulars returning; pop ~10:15pm. Visits from upstairs office guests, Fishmonger crew and Maiz de la Vida friends. Low: Hazy, Seedlip Agave. No incidents. Final Destination screening was a hit.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 10/7 (AM MOD Evan + Josh; PM MOD Sanders + Walcott).** Net sales incl. events $18,386 vs target $9,077 (+102.6%). Core net $9,178 (DC/AM $1,201, D&C PM $7,977, Garden/6A $1,605); net event sales $9,208. Food incl. events $10,482. 177 guests (Tock). Comps $313 — 'homies in the house'. Day 2 of Global Healthcare event (50 guests, 7:30am-5pm, all spaces) went smoothly with large breakfast/lunch/snacks; day 3 tomorrow. Super chill Wednesday evening in the lobby ('never filled all the way up'); opener cut before 8pm. Solo garden day ($1,606). Kitchen: hood vents cleaned. No-shows charged. No incidents. Favorite: Megan from Uchiko + family, and staff crushing service and weekly sidework.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD Kyler).** Net sales $4,235 vs target $4,649 (-8.9%). Food $116, beverage $4,093, retail $26. 130 guests (SevenRooms), $34 check avg. Comps $56.10 (1.3%). Slow but promising start building to full by 8:30pm; several ghost reservations built a waitlist (completed ~10:30pm); midnight wave of night-cappers incl. a 7-top. Maia training on floor; Sean's first day live in the well went great. Comic Con visitors in town. Notable guests: Bruce from Amor, David Ebert from Attaboy, Devon Tarby's family. Jayson Chang 8-top kept pushing back and never came. No no-shows. Menu count 18/18. Breakage: 1 SOF, 1 DOF. Kitchen: snacks only. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Finally not hot, nice and warm
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD & Chef Julian, Josh, Kevin).** Net sales $4,919 vs target $5,363 (-8.3%). Food $828 (all Marquee). 126 guests, $39.05 check avg. Comps $224. Super solid shift — full house for a while with two servers and two bartenders; some investors visited; party of seven seated at tables 14-16. Started enforcing no-ID-no-entry (physical ID required). Both new servers did well. Kitchen: Kevin one-man band killed it. Low: toilet paper. Reservation no-shows charged. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD Marcus).** Net sales incl. events $3,442.02 vs target $2,902 (+18.6%). Marquee bar sales $3,788.63 (gross), food $382.90. 77 guests (52 walk-ins / 25 reso), GCA $40.03. Comps $143.84 (community/investor 12.12, industry 65.72 — some investor discounts mis-entered as industry, employee 32, service recovery 22, DNL 12). Slow start allowed ABK and steps-of-service training (Devan/Teleia); steady pace ~7-9pm, last guests ~10:30. Garden used briefly for the weather. Maintenance: garbage disposal drain clogged (service tomorrow), curtain, glass rinser. Focus: slow down and double-check POS entries. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Breezy and cool morning with rising temperatures
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 10/7 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Drew).** Net sales $5,651 vs target $5,163 (+9.5%). Bar AM $721, PM $4,603, Sun Club $238, Hot Eye closed. Food $2,064. 136 guests (OpenTable: 29 AM + 107 PM). Comps $182. Only 7 guests before noon; three food tours drove morning business. Evening started slow with no pre-show rush from the Lucas Theater; cut down to four, decent post-show crowd. Sun Club: perfect weather, light traffic. Kitchen cut one cook midway; no 86s or complaints. Maintenance: Crisalli still down. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 10/7 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net sales $8,311 vs target $9,695 (-14.3%). Food $1,777. 162 guests, $51.62 avg spend. Comps $518.14 (5.9%) — lots of industry plus a couple recoveries. Slower start; notable guests incl. Paul Clark (Imbibe), Jack Ross (UVI), Carrie (Populus), Ryan Granger (Babayaga). Good investor/member showing, 2-3 walk-in members without reservations accommodated easily. Kitchen walloped at ~$1,800 — moving to 2 in kitchen is the right move; new brie-style cheese went over well. Few DNLs. Maintenance: out of floor cleaner (Auto-Chlor emailed). 86: Fords, Punt e Mes, Titos, St Germain. No incidents.
